title: Not Me
content:
Feels like no one cares for me,
Feels like no one's here for me.

If I show this to you you may rush to me,
See if everything's okay, show your love to me,
Ask if something bad happened, console me,
Tell me that 'this' is not your version of me.

I have another side of me,
Being awesome with everyone I see.

My friends are awesome,
We spend a lot of good time together.
Do I enjoy? If you may ask,
Yes he does, not me.

I have been developing a lot of things,
Winning a lot of contests,
Getting recognized as the smartest kid.
Do I celebrate? If you may ask,
Yes he does, not me.

I think I have become somewhat of a man.
Not because I spend my time working,
Not because I care for people around me,
Not because I am trying to earn,
Not because I have learnt to lie,
But maybe as I forgot to cry.

Even If I did cry,
Who would know?
Who would see beside the face I show?

But, why do I need someone to see?
'Happiness being alone is what you should seek'
Isn't that what people say?

I have friends,
I have laptop,
I have internet,
I have money,
I am somewhat smart,
I score good,
I think I make others smile,
Still..
Am I happy? If you may ask,
Yes he is, not me.

I don't know what I lack,
I don't know what I need,
With time I will heal,
Console myself, smile again,
At least, that's how it has been.

Cuz I do what I wanna do I dont think about others
I fly high as I wanna be I dont mind the weather

title: My Star
content:
I was looking up at the night sky,
I found something was missing....

Then, I looked at you,
Sitting right beside me.
A place, reserved only for you,

I wondered, how could you shine so bright?
How could you smile even in the darkest Night?
If I was a poet, I would compare you to a star,
That came down from afar.

I saw your hand resting on the grass,
And though its been some time, since we're together,
Still I am somewhat shy ,
To hold your hand and let the moment be forever.

Slowly I crawled my fingers towards yours,

The Moment was bound,
Then Again, I looked at the sky,
Something was missing,
Oh right! One star came down.

title: Keep looking out of the window
content:
So, I spent the entire day working from 11 am till 8 pm without talking with anyone or resting. Then papa ne movie ki tickets book kardi to 9 baje jana pada. We were 7 people in the car. Everyone was talking with each other having normal conversations like normal people. And then there was me just looking outside the window. Some 1 year ago, when I was in a situation like this I used to secretly text a certain someone and eagerly wait to get out of this and get the chance to talk with that person. Alas! Now I have no one I would wanna wait for.
It's not like I miss that person. I miss the feeling of waiting for someone knowing that they must be waiting for you too. I wish I had that. I wish I had someone to talk to. I wish I had someone who would pick up my calls. I wish I had someone who wanted to talk to me. I wish a lot of things. Maybe one day these whishes will come true. Till then, all I can do is wait and keep looking out of the window.

title: Dost
content:
Wo kya hai na,
Hum sirf dost hai.
Mai tujhe zyada kuch bata nahi sakta,
Mai tujhse zyada abhi jata nahi sakta,

Tum kehte to ho ki pyaar hai,
Batate bhi ho,
Jatate bhi ho,
Magar,
Kuch baat karne tujhe paas mai bula nahi sakta,
Paas baithakar dil ko sehla nahi sakta,
Wo kya hai na,
Hum sirf dost hai

Teri aakhon se ashqon ko mita nahi sakta,
Tere lafzo ki maayusi jhata nahi sakta,
Tere sapno ko sach se saja nahi sakta,
Teri khwaishon ko apne sapne banane ka haq jata nahi sakta.
Kyun?
Wo kya hai na hum bas dost hai.

Teri nazron ke hazaro nazaro mein,
Mai drishya apne basa nahi sakta.
Ye jo shaamein tere saath ki hai,
Un shaamon mei sadiyan bita nahi sakta.
Ye waqt kyun mai Thama nahi sakta?
Tu jaaa raha hai zara zara,
Mai yu darr raha hu har pal har sama,
Hamari dosti ke bikharne ke darr se kyun tujhko dara nahi sakta.
Theek hai sadiyan to nahi par kya kuch aur shaamein tere sath bhi ab mai bita nahi sakta?

Kya hum abhi bhi...?

In khayalon mein,
khwaabon mein
Meri ankhon ke nazaron mein,
Hai kayi in behti baharon mein
Magar milega kahan tumhare jaisa
In rishton ke bazaron mein.

Ab to kuch bataya jaata hi nahi,
Ab to kuch jataya jaata hi nahi,
Ab sajane ke liye koi sapna bhi nahi,
Aur kehlane ke liye tu apna bhi nahi.
Kehne ke liye hum jaankar to hai,
Magar bitane ke liye sadiyan, shaamein, ya kuch pal bhi nahi.
Wo kya hai na,
Ab hum dost bhi nahi.

Magar fir bhi,
Jab arso mei koi ek mulaqat ho,
Nazron mei nazare tumhare abaad ho,
Chahe bin ashqon ke kisi baat ka dhukh mehsoos ho,
Us ek pal bhi,
Tumhari muskaan se zaroori kuch nahi,
Tumhari aankhon ki chamak se tez roshani kuch nahi.
Apne khayal, sawal aur pareshaniyan hatake,
Itni sadiyon ke baad bhi,
Agar mehsoos kara paya ki kuch badla nahi,
Shayad kehla paunga apne aap ko ek achcha dost tabhi.
Wo kya hai na,
Hum dost the kabhi

title: Lives of us
content:
Dances of us can't last quite long,
Unknown to me, they end before the good part of our song.

Songs of us, can't rhyme all along,
But at least we sing, with the lyrics all gone wrong.

Voices of us are unheard, in the chaos they are lost.
I wonder if we listen to each other atleast in our thoughts?

Thoughts of us, for each other, do not cross the same bounds,
Bounds, set by memories , complex for me, that go all around.

Memories of us bundle moments of love.
Love that exists with no expectations of us.

Love of us, non-existential as it may be,
Sometimes, allows us to just be and dance across life.

And,
Dances of us can't last quite long,
Unknown to me, they end before the good part of our song.

title: Pictures
content:

title: Ashima
content:
If this was a dream let's watch it together,
If this was a painting let us paint forever.

If this was a wish let us not lose hope,
If this was a gift let us keep it closed.

For if we stop watching,
Stop painting,
Lose hope,
Or decide to see what it is,

We will come out of our imaginations,
Our lives with dreamy translations.

Let us draw out what feels unreal,
Let us paint how we see us.

And for the gift,
Let it be unknown, a curious mystery.
As when we meet again,
Let it be a reason for the fun
And for another page in our history.

In aankhon mein teri,
Nigaahon se meri,
Mai jhaankh ke dekhun,
Hai jo asliyat mei nahi.

Jab milne ka samay subah chaar hota tha,
Jab haath pakadna izhaar hota tha,
Jisey pata saari batein sachcha yaar hota tha.
Jab pehli nazar mei pehle pyaar hota tha.

content:

With the setting sun, good relations I break.

For the things I wanna say, I lack courage.

For the things that I have you lack interest

title: Reflections Of Us
content:
With the reminder of the right time, I seek to wish.
The wish at midnight for her joy and bliss.
A joy so rare cause the one to remember was me.
Or maybe it was the event? The moment? The time?
Or is it really true that I can be the reason for the smile?
Really? A joy so incomparable ‘cause the one to remember was me??
---
In all of the memories of you, I wonder what’s true!
In all of the truth I see, I wonder who’s you!
As when the truth has a filter,
I wonder if just the memories are false
Or if you and I in our own memories are false too?
---
The sides of division that lie across,
Call me to be with them, not simple as a toss.
The line that divides gets blurred and thinned,
As the eyes are none but my biases within.
---
In the end, on your remembrance,
I have a photo and a memory.
I wonder which one I hold more dear,
The one which is clear or the one which is blurry?

If asked to tell which is of more importance,
Do I see you in the picture as clear as it shines?
Or feel your warmth in my imagination
With a hazy view of your smile?

If asked to keep one, how do I choose?
Do I save you for future family for them to know a lifeless soul?
Or do I keep you safe with just me
And then cherish all our beautiful moments till my last call?

But what if the memory of you degrades with time?
Will I loose you, your warmth and your smile?
I guess the photo is better since I can see it all day,
It is gonna stay and even if it degrades, it will do it slow.
Just then, the winds blew, carried the picture and tore it all the way,
I guess, for the better of it, the memory was stronger than the photo.

title: Conversations Two
content:
If I was a flower, Would I withstand winds flowing strong?
Or break apart in the chaos of rain and thunderstorms?
If I was a flower, Would I bring you joy?
Or cut through your bright smiles with my natural thorns?

When you look at me with the hazy glare,
I question, If I should be the flower so rare.
With the shining sun and a soft breeze I tend to sway,
But so do all other flowers to compare.

The more you look at me,
The more I shy away.
Just a plant on the field,
The beauty must be your eyes to say.
For you see me more colorful than I am,
And moreover when my true colors are not at play.
In your eyes, joyous, hopeful and admirable, I might be today,
But I feel I am not a flower yet,
Just a bud on the way

content:

If what I say could speak 1000 ways,

R:

If you pebble your 100 stories,

I have a lot of fables, for you, I'll read them 1 by 1,

Would you walk along the same path I walk?

content:
You do great things, amazed by the actions, I join my hands, praise you for my life's span.
I might walk right beside you, help in any way I can, learn in all ways I can.

You show me great things,
Done and dusted in the past,

Or subdue myself only in the greatness of great beings?

Beings, with
Two eyes, One mind,

title: A Day To Remember
content:
If your grandkids ask you,
"Who wrote this poem ?"
You would tell them its me,
By the day with me that you would remember.

A day to remember
Would be the day we met,
In a new place and among all new faces,
Behind masks of safety,
And a share of generosity,
Our friendship was set.

A day to remember
Would be when we used to have lunch,
So much to talk about and so many flavors,
And lots of random fun.

In all of those days,
I still was somewhat shy.
And you had a space of yourself
Not allowed to many,
But with soft understandings,
In that space of yours, sometimes, I could stand by.

A day to remember
Would be when in the blast of celebration,
We exchanged personal situations.
It left a mark, on my view of you.
Crazy and bubbly as you may be,
You still are Aishwarya, with a soft and strong heart,
Which makes you "you".

A day to remember
Would be the event of halloween.
A crazy day, a first for me.
And an ending as perfect as warm as it could have ever been.

A day to remember
Would be filming you so many times,
An experience as a director,
All for a reel and crazyy vibes.

A day to remember
Would be dancing with you.
The only dance I properly know,
And among all of the others,
The only one who remembers the steps till now is you.

A day to remember
Would be the pretty and cozy ethnic day.
From shooting and trying ramp walks with you,
To actually doing a ramp walk,
That day made me come a long way.

Through all of those days,
Your trust and care for me was constant, only more to grow,
As I developed and understood the world around,
As I learned to express, feel emotions, and tried a little to show.

Some days to remember
Would be me with my long hair,
And you with your colors,
Me with your iPhone,
And at the end of that day,
You with only a thousand pictures

A day to remember
Would be us painting tshirts.
A day to remember
Would be us graduating from college.
A day to remember
Would be us on a date, that didn't happen.

A day to remember
Would not be today
As this day is filled with goodbyes.
A day to remember
Would not be today
And if this letter makes you remember it, throw it away.

But then how would you remember me?
Honestly,
I don't even know if these are the days you'll remember me by.
And for when your grandkids ask of me,
Maybe you can introduce me as,
"The uncle who used to make you smile”

title: Conversations Three
content:
If I knew what's wrong
Maybe, I would live a better life.
In my head, If I knew,
How to love and tell it out loud
It would be louder than the noise.

The seeds of love,
To be sown with love,
Are something unseen, unfelt,
With hopes of growth everyday.
As they can only be planted by others,
As I fail to live the love within myself.

The seeds of love,
To be grown with love,
Deep within, yet unfound,
Its waiting for the waters of "I love you".

I love the way you look,
I love the way you walk.
I love it how with a small effort,
I always make you smile.
And I await for you to do the same, to tell me the same,
For you to fit in for me,
Make small efforts, Tell me a joke sometimes.
Even If I feel no different, I would still smile for you tried.

I love to sit silently with you,
Would you love it too ?
Or Is it boredom for you, as it shows.
And alone, one-sided, my love grows.

I dreamt,
I dreamt to find a bond,
To feel the love and why is it an emotion so strong.
I thought I could feel it in my mind,
Water the seeds myself,
Maybe with the sunlight of hope it grows along.
But If I gave all in for self,
How would I make you smile?
How would I help you feel loved?
How would I make you feel okay, When you feel its all wrong?

The seeds stay, as they were I think
Waiting,
Deep alone they exist,
To be watered by you,
And as I am reaching my end,
I doubt, If they were ever there to begin with!

title: Flowers and sweets
content:
In sun-shining days
With you faraway
I still see you around in crowded streets.
With a smile so pretty
And anger so gritty
How are you so flowers and sweets?

A look at your face,
At the start of my days,
Makes me go sleep, and see you again,
Again and again, back in my dreams.

Every word that you say, feels like a poem,
Every song that you sing,
Feels like I am listening,
Alive in an heaven, to angels with wings.


Your cheeky little jokes,
All lame and so forced,
Makes me smile anyways, and then you find peace.
Why is all of this,
Only true in a dream?
Why does the life I live,
Is not sweet as in the song it all seems.
